harnessCorrections.change: Online cases that require thinking now explicitly request high reasoning effort instead of assuming reasoning appears for every ordinary request.
Online runners now close diagnostics, request-ledger and deep-capture stores before deleting temporary state instead of sleeping and swallowing EBUSY cleanup failures.
Restart coverage now closes the old composition resources and creates a fresh composition/runtime against the same persisted Responses state before the continuation turn.
Codex/Claude directed tool prompts name the actually advertised tools and prohibit unrelated planning, delegation and artifact inspection while retaining the original tool/result assertions.

transientAttempts.diagnosis: The case asserted thinking without explicitly requesting reasoning; the harness was corrected to make the requirement part of the request.
Ten JSON jobs required reasoning while sending no reasoning request; the harness now sends reasoning.effort=high only where reasoning is asserted.
